digest.component_or_area: agent process lifecycle management and resource cleanup
propositions: Subagents spawning CPU saturation workers without lifetime bounds or reaping leave orphaned PPID-1 processes that run unbounded, accumulating massive CPU time over days.
38 ad-hoc `python -c 'while True: pass'` workers spawned on 2026-08-22 orphaned to PID 1 and ran continuously for four days at ~1341% combined CPU until manually killed.

Agent guidance must require bounding all background load generators at spawn time with `timeout`, process-group teardown with `trap 'kill 0' EXIT INT TERM`, and explicit reaping including on error paths to prevent PPID-1 orphans.

A detection check must identify compute processes with PPID 1 and accumulated CPU time exceeding a threshold (default 3600 CPU-seconds), while filtering system-owned processes by path prefix to reduce noise on macOS.

The check must be injectable for testing without spawning real CPU burners, provide read-only smoke assertion against live process state, and offer `--include-system` flag to override system-path filtering.
